profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer | Problem Solver
profile.summary:
Passionate and curious. Looking for challenges.

I have 27 years of experience across different areas, including systems administration, database administration, network administration, systems programming, infrastructure (on-premise and cloud), backend development.

This experience has uniquely equipped me to approach projects in a holistic way, with an open mind, balancing trade-offs, always with the goal in sight. Sometimes learning or even inventing something new in the process.

The result is a carefully designed and crafted solution, where I poured my creativity, applying best practices to achieve a high quality, easy to maintain, deliverable.

I’m easy to work with, with a positive attitude, that reaches out across teams to accomplish goals.
